description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class `SavingsActivityPriorToClientTransferException` which extends `AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException`. It is used within the Fineract project to signal errors related to attempts to perform savings activities before a client's transfer date.

classes.name: SavingsActivityPriorToClientTransferException
classes.description: A domain-specific exception indicating that a savings activity was attempted prior to the client's transfer date.

methods.name: SavingsActivityPriorToClientTransferException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific action and message arguments, constructing an error message indicating that the attempted action is not permitted before the client's transfer date.
